description: Builds the USDC transfer of the Check price for the networks and paid tools chosen (networks from check_info checkNetworks, tools from check_info toolOffer: the sum of each tool at its own price, never above its maximum) from payer to the analysis fee wallet on chainId (any network of check_info networks), for the payer to sign. The credit is bound to those networks. Needs buyProof, the purchase proof of THIS payer from check_buy_proof (the payer signed and passed the free screening); without it, or with another wallet's, check_buy_proof_required (401). The server also measures the sender on-chain. Returns { check { id, status awaiting_payment, amount, amountRaw, token, feeWallet, tools (exactly what this Check reads) }, skippedChecks? (tools asked for that are switched off or not on sale, left out and not charged), transaction, plan (buildId check-<id>, steps on EVM or transaction on Solana), report }. check.id (CHK-...) names this Check: keep it private and keep it to come back to the result; analysing and reading it also take the payer's proof (this buyProof for 10 minutes, or the Check access). Each call makes a NEW Check, good for 30 minutes (expiresAt): a transaction mined after that is credited by the price of now on the networks it covers (check_report_payment). Pass checkId of one still awaiting payment and in its time to rebuild its transfer (the Solana one expires in about a minute). Sign the transaction exactly as returned: it carries the mark of THIS Check (16 bytes after the transfer arguments on EVM, a memo on Solana). A transfer you build yourself is refused with analysis_payment_rejected reason charge_not_tied after the money left: do not pay again, prove the wallet with destination_challenge (receiver = details.feeWallet, chargeId = the check id, chargeTxHash = that hash) and destination_authorize, then report the same hash again. Refusals: analysis_tool_unavailable (503, a tool is down: nothing is built), check_credit_limit (409), payer_blocked (403), check_network_unsupported (400), check_networks_required (400), check_already_paid (409, checkId of a paid Check), check_charge_expired (409), kyc_required (403, tools with crystal and no approved KYC), invalid_check (400, tools empty, repeated or unknown), check_unavailable (503, no tool chosen is on sale).

buyProof.description: The purchase proof of this payer from check_buy_proof (vcb_..., 10 minutes). Secret.

chainId.description: EVM: integer from GET /v1/chains (1, 10, 56, 100, 137, 8453, 42161, 43114, 130). Solana: string from GET /v1/svm/chains ("solana-mainnet").

checkId.description: Optional: a Check still awaiting payment, to rebuild its transfer instead of making a new Check.

creditId.description: Optional: a given-back credit of THIS payer (returnedCredit of check_analyze, a free credit with returnedOf) to take off the price, so only the difference is paid (owner, 25/11/2026). Only when tools include its tools and networks are exactly its networks; the answer has check.creditApplied { amount }. The credit is spent when this charge is paid; if it was spent elsewhere first, the purchase credits only the tools the payment covered. Refusals: check_credit_unavailable (409), check_credit_not_covered (400, details.tools and networks), check_credit_covers_all (409: use the credit by itself with check_analyze).

networks.description: The networks to analyse, from check_info checkNetworks (e.g. ["1","8453","solana-mainnet"]). The price is perNetwork times these, never above maximum.

payer.description: The paying wallet, the one that signs the transfer (0x on EVM, base58 on Solana).

tools.description: The paid tools to buy, at least one, each once (owner, 18/11/2026: one mark per paid tool): any of "scorechain" (once per wallet), "merkle-science" and "crystal" (once per network), from check_info toolOffer. The Check reads and shows ONLY these, plus the free OFAC and issuer freeze screening. crystal only for a payer whose identity check (KYC) is approved: otherwise kyc_required (403) and nothing is built. Left out, the pair scorechain and merkle-science (older clients). Here ["crystal"] means Crystal ALONE (CLI 0.3.15 and older, on the /v1, still get the pair plus Crystal for it).

name: check_charge
